ayahs.arabicText: حٰمٓۚ
ayahs.translation: Ha'. Mim.

ayahs.arabicText: تَنْزِیْلُ الْكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الْعَزِیْزِ الْعَلِیْمِۙ
ayahs.translation: This Book is a revelation from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing;

ayahs.arabicText: غَافِرِ الذَّنْۢبِ وَ قَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِیْدِ الْعِقَابِ١ۙ ذِی الطَّوْلِ١ؕ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١ؕ اِلَیْهِ الْمَصِیْرُ
ayahs.translation: the Forgiver of sins, the Accepter of repentance, the Stern in retribution, the Bountiful. There is no god but He. To Him are all destined to return.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا یُجَادِلُ فِیْۤ اٰیٰتِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا فَلَا یَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِی الْبِلَادِ
ayahs.translation: None but the unbelievers dispute regarding the Signs of Allah. So let not their strutting about in the land delude you.

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ وَّ الْاَحْزَابُ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ١۪ وَ هَمَّتْ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُوْلِهِمْ لِیَاْخُذُوْهُ وَ جٰدَلُوْا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِیُدْحِضُوْا بِهِ الْحَقَّ فَاَخَذْتُهُمْ١۫ فَكَیْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
ayahs.translation: Before them the people of Noah also gave the lie (to Messengers), and so did many parties after them. Each nation sallied forth against its Messenger to seize him, and they disputed with false arguments seeking therewith to repudiate the Truth. Then I seized them; and behold, how woeful was My retribution!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اَنَّهُمْ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِۘؔ
ayahs.translation: Thus has the decree of your Lord become due against the unbelievers. They are destined for the Fire.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّذِیْنَ یَحْمِلُوْنَ الْعَرْشَ وَ مَنْ حَوْلَهٗ یُسَبِّحُوْنَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَ یُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ وَ یَسْتَغْفِرُوْنَ لِلَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا١ۚ رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَّ عِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِیْنَ تَابُوْا وَ اتَّبَعُوْا سَبِیْلَكَ وَ قِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: The angels that bear the Throne and those that are around to extol your Lord's glory with His praise, they believe in Him, and ask forgiveness for the believers, saying: “Our Lord! You encompass everything with Your Mercy and Knowledge. So forgive those that repent and follow Your Path, and guard them against the chastisement of Hell.

ayahs.arabicText: رَبَّنَا وَ اَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنّٰتِ عَدْنِ اِ۟لَّتِیْ وَعَدْتَّهُمْ وَ مَنْ صَلَحَ مِنْ اٰبَآئِهِمْ وَ اَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَ ذُرِّیّٰتِهِمْ١ؕ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِیْزُ الْحَكِیْمُۙ
ayahs.translation: Our Lord, admit them to the everlasting Gardens You have promised them and those of their fathers and spouses and progeny that were righteous. Surely You alone are Most Mighty, Most Wise;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قِهِمُ السَّیِّاٰتِ١ؕ وَ مَنْ تَقِ السَّیِّاٰتِ یَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهٗ١ؕ وَ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and guard them against all ills. He whom You guard against ills on that Day, to him You have surely been Most Merciful. That is the great triumph.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا یُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ اللّٰهِ اَكْبَرُ مِنْ مَّقْتِكُمْ اَنْفُسَكُمْ اِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ اِلَى الْاِیْمَانِ فَتَكْفُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It will be announced to the unbelievers (on the Day of Resurrection): “Surely Allah's abhorrence of you when you were called to believe but you disbelieved was greater than is your abhorrence of yourselves today.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَاۤ اَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَیْنِ وَ اَحْیَیْتَنَا اثْنَتَیْنِ فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوْبِنَا فَهَلْ اِلٰى خُرُوْجٍ مِّنْ سَبِیْلٍ
ayahs.translation: They will say: “Our Lord, twice have You caused us to die and twice have You given us life. We have now confessed our sins. Is there, then, any way out?”

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكُمْ بِاَنَّهٗۤ اِذَا دُعِیَ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ كَفَرْتُمْ١ۚ وَ اِنْ یُّشْرَكْ بِهٖ تُؤْمِنُوْا١ؕ فَالْحُكْمُ لِلّٰهِ الْعَلِیِّ الْكَبِیْرِ
ayahs.translation: (They will be told): “(The cause of your present state is that) when Allah alone was invoked, you disbelieved; and when others instead of Him were invoked, you believed. Today all judgement lies with Allah, the Most High, the All-Great.”

ayahs.arabicText: هُوَ الَّذِیْ یُرِیْكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ وَ یُنَزِّلُ لَكُمْ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ رِزْقًا١ؕ وَ مَا یَتَذَكَّرُ اِلَّا مَنْ یُّنِیْبُ
ayahs.translation: He it is Who shows you His Signs and sends down provision for you from the sky. Yet none takes heed except he who constantly turns to Allah.

ayahs.arabicText: فَادْعُوا اللّٰهَ مُخْلِصِیْنَ لَهُ الدِّیْنَ وَ لَوْ كَرِهَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So call upon Allah, consecrating all your devotion to Him, howsoever much the unbelievers may dislike it.

ayahs.arabicText: رَفِیْعُ الدَّرَجٰتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ١ۚ یُلْقِی الرُّوْحَ مِنْ اَمْرِهٖ عَلٰى مَنْ یَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖ لِیُنْذِرَ یَوْمَ التَّلَاقِۙ
ayahs.translation: Exalted in Rank, Lord of the Throne: He causes the spirit to descend on whomsoever of His servants He pleases so as to warn them of the Day of Encounter;

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ هُمْ بٰرِزُوْنَ١ۚ۬ لَا یَخْفٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ مِنْهُمْ شَیْءٌ١ؕ لِمَنِ الْمُلْكُ الْیَوْمَ١ؕ لِلّٰهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ
ayahs.translation: the Day when they will emerge and nothing of them shall be hidden from Allah. (On that Day they will be asked): “Whose is the kingdom today?” (The whole world will cry out): “It is Allah's, the One, the Overpowering.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَلْیَوْمَ تُجْزٰى كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ١ؕ لَا ظُلْمَ الْیَوْمَ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِیْعُ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.translation: (It will then be said): “Today shall everyone be fully recompensed for his deeds. None shall be wronged today. Surely Allah is Swift in Reckoning.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنْذِرْهُمْ یَوْمَ الْاٰزِفَةِ اِذِ الْقُلُوْبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كٰظِمِیْنَ١ؕ۬ مَا لِلظّٰلِمِیْنَ مِنْ حَمِیْمٍ وَّ لَا شَفِیْعٍ یُّطَاعُؕ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), then warn them of the Day that has drawn near, the Day when hearts full of suppressed grief will leap up to the throats and the wrong-doers shall neither have any sincere friend nor intercessor whose word will be heeded.

ayahs.arabicText: یَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ الْاَعْیُنِ وَ مَا تُخْفِی الصُّدُوْرُ
ayahs.translation: He knows even the most stealthy glance of the eyes and all the secrets that hearts conceal.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اللّٰهُ یَقْضِیْ بِالْحَقِّ١ؕ وَ الَّذِیْنَ یَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ لَا یَقْضُوْنَ بِشَیْءٍ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ السَّمِیْعُ الْبَصِیْرُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Allah will judge with justice, whereas those whom they call upon beside Him cannot judge at all. Surely Allah -- and He alone -- is All- Hearing, All-Seeing.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَسِیْرُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ فَیَنْظُرُوْا كَیْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِیْنَ كَانُوْا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ١ؕ كَانُوْا هُمْ اَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَّ اٰثَارًا فِی الْاَرْضِ فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِذُنُوْبِهِمْ١ؕ وَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنْ وَّاقٍ
ayahs.translation: Have they not journeyed in the land that they might observe the end of those who came before them? They were even greater in strength than they and left behind more splendid traces in the land. Then Allah seized them because of their sins and they had none who could protect them from Allah.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَانَتْ تَّاْتِیْهِمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَیِّنٰتِ فَكَفَرُوْا فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ قَوِیٌّ شَدِیْدُ الْعِقَابِ
ayahs.translation: They came to this end because their Messengers would come to them with Clear Signs and yet they would refuse to believe. So Allah seized them. He is indeed Strong, Terrible in Retribution.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوْسٰى بِاٰیٰتِنَا وَ سُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِیْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Verily We sent Moses with Our Signs and a clear authority

ayahs.arabicText: اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَ هَامٰنَ وَ قَارُوْنَ فَقَالُوْا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
ayahs.translation: to Pharaoh and Haman and Korah. They said: “(He is) a sorcerer, an utter liar.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوا اقْتُلُوْۤا اَبْنَآءَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهٗ وَ اسْتَحْیُوْا نِسَآءَهُمْ١ؕ وَ مَا كَیْدُ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ اِلَّا فِیْ ضَلٰلٍ
ayahs.translation: When Moses brought them the Truth from Us they said: “Kill the sons of all the believers who have joined him, but spare the women.” The guile of the unbelievers always ends in vain.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُوْنِیْۤ اَقْتُلْ مُوْسٰى وَ لْیَدْعُ رَبَّهٗ١ۚ اِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ اَنْ یُّبَدِّلَ دِیْنَكُمْ اَوْ اَنْ یُّظْهِرَ فِی الْاَرْضِ الْفَسَادَ
ayahs.translation: One day Pharaoh said: “Let me go and kill Moses; then let him invoke his Lord. I fear that he will change your religion or cause disruption in the land.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ مُوْسٰۤى اِنِّیْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّیْ وَ رَبِّكُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا یُؤْمِنُ بِیَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Moses said: “I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord from everyone who waxes arrogant and does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مُّؤْمِنٌ١ۖۗ مِّنْ اٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَ یَكْتُمُ اِیْمَانَهٗۤ اَتَقْتُلُوْنَ رَجُلًا اَنْ یَّقُوْلَ رَبِّیَ اللّٰهُ وَ قَدْ جَآءَكُمْ بِالْبَیِّنٰتِ مِنْ رَّبِّكُمْ١ؕ وَ اِنْ یَّكُ كَاذِبًا فَعَلَیْهِ كَذِبُهٗ١ۚ وَ اِنْ یَّكُ صَادِقًا یُّصِبْكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِیْ یَعِدُكُمْ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا یَهْدِیْ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ
ayahs.translation: Then a man endowed with faith, from Pharaoh's folk, who had kept his faith hidden, said: “Do you kill a person simply because he says: 'My Lord is Allah' even though he brought to you clear Signs from your Lord? If he is a liar, his lying will recoil upon him; but if he is truthful, you will be smitten with some of the awesome consequences of which he warns you. Allah does not guide to the Right Way any who exceeds the limits and is an utter liar.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰقَوْمِ لَكُمُ الْمُلْكُ الْیَوْمَ ظٰهِرِیْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ١٘ فَمَنْ یَّنْصُرُنَا مِنْۢ بَاْسِ اللّٰهِ اِنْ جَآءَنَا١ؕ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَاۤ اُرِیْكُمْ اِلَّا مَاۤ اَرٰى وَ مَاۤ اَهْدِیْكُمْ اِلَّا سَبِیْلَ الرَّشَادِ
ayahs.translation: My people, today the kingdom is yours, and you are supreme in the land. But if Allah's chastisement were to come upon you, who will come to our help?” Pharaoh said: “I only counsel what I consider right; I only direct you to the Path of Rectitude.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْۤ اٰمَنَ یٰقَوْمِ اِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ عَلَیْكُمْ مِّثْلَ یَوْمِ الْاَحْزَابِۙ
ayahs.translation: He who had faith said: “My people, I fear that you will confront a day like that which overtook many parties before you,

ayahs.arabicText: مِثْلَ دَاْبِ قَوْمِ نُوْحٍ وَّ عَادٍ وَّ ثَمُوْدَ وَ الَّذِیْنَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ١ؕ وَ مَا اللّٰهُ یُرِیْدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعِبَادِ
ayahs.translation: like the day that overtook the people of Noah and Ad and Thamud, and those who came after them. Allah does not wish to subject His servants to any injustice.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ اِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ عَلَیْكُمْ یَوْمَ التَّنَادِۙ
ayahs.translation: My people, I fear that you will encounter a day when there will be much wailing and you will cry out to one another for help,

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ تُوَلُّوْنَ مُدْبِرِیْنَ١ۚ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ١ۚ وَ مَنْ یُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ هَادٍ
ayahs.translation: the day when you will turn around to retreat, there will be none to protect you from Allah. He whom Allah lets go astray, none will be able to show him the Right Way.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ یُوْسُفُ مِنْ قَبْلُ بِالْبَیِّنٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِیْ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُمْ بِهٖ١ؕ حَتّٰۤى اِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَنْ یَّبْعَثَ اللّٰهُ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ رَسُوْلًا١ؕ كَذٰلِكَ یُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُّرْتَابُۚۖ
ayahs.translation: Verily Joseph came to you with Clear Signs before, yet you continued to doubt his Message. Thereafter when he died, you said: 'Allah shall send no Messenger after him.'” Thus Allah leads astray those who transgress the limits and are given to much doubting;

ayahs.arabicText: اِ۟لَّذِیْنَ یُجَادِلُوْنَ فِیْۤ اٰیٰتِ اللّٰهِ بِغَیْرِ سُلْطٰنٍ اَتٰىهُمْ١ؕ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ وَ عِنْدَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا١ؕ كَذٰلِكَ یَطْبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ
ayahs.translation: those who contend regarding Allah's Signs without any evidence that might have come to them. That is exceedingly loathsome to Allah and to those that believe. Thus does Allah seal the heart of everyone who is proud and high-handed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ یٰهَامٰنُ ابْنِ لِیْ صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّیْۤ اَبْلُغُ الْاَسْبَابَۙ
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: “Haman, build for me a lofty tower that I may scale the highways --

ayahs.arabicText: اَسْبَابَ السَّمٰوٰتِ فَاَطَّلِعَ اِلٰۤى اِلٰهِ مُوْسٰى وَ اِنِّیْ لَاَظُنُّهٗ كَاذِبًا١ؕ وَ كَذٰلِكَ زُیِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوْٓءُ عَمَلِهٖ وَ صُدَّ عَنِ السَّبِیْلِ١ؕ وَ مَا كَیْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ اِلَّا فِیْ تَبَابٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: the highways to the heavens -- and have a look at the God of Moses, although I am certain that Moses is a liar.” Thus Pharaoh's evil deed was made to seem fair to him, and he was barred from the Right Path. Pharaoh's guile only led him to his own perdition.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْۤ اٰمَنَ یٰقَوْمِ اتَّبِعُوْنِ اَهْدِكُمْ سَبِیْلَ الرَّشَادِۚ
ayahs.translation: The person endowed with faith said: “My people, follow me; I shall direct you to the Path of Rectitude.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰقَوْمِ اِنَّمَا هٰذِهِ الْحَیٰوةُ الدُّنْیَا مَتَاعٌ١٘ وَّ اِنَّ الْاٰخِرَةَ هِیَ دَارُ الْقَرَارِ
ayahs.translation: My people, the life of this world is ephemeral, whereas the Hereafter, that is the permanent abode.

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَیِّئَةً فَلَا یُجْزٰۤى اِلَّا مِثْلَهَا١ۚ وَ مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّنْ ذَكَرٍ اَوْ اُنْثٰى وَ هُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ یَدْخُلُوْنَ الْجَنَّةَ یُرْزَقُوْنَ فِیْهَا بِغَیْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.translation: Whosoever does an evil deed will be requited only with the like of it; and whosoever acts righteously and has attained to faith -- be he a male or a female -- they shall enter Paradise and be provided sustenance beyond all reckoning.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ مَا لِیْۤ اَدْعُوْكُمْ اِلَى النَّجٰوةِ وَ تَدْعُوْنَنِیْۤ اِلَى النَّارِؕ
ayahs.translation: My people, how is it that I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire;

ayahs.arabicText: تَدْعُوْنَنِیْ لِاَكْفُرَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ اُشْرِكَ بِهٖ مَا لَیْسَ لِیْ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ١٘ وَّ اَنَا اَدْعُوْكُمْ اِلَى الْعَزِیْزِ الْغَفَّارِ
ayahs.translation: you call me to deny Allah and to associate with Him as His partners those regarding whom I have no knowledge (that they are Allah's partners in His Divinity), whereas I call you to the Most Mighty, the Most Forgiving?

ayahs.arabicText: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّمَا تَدْعُوْنَنِیْۤ اِلَیْهِ لَیْسَ لَهٗ دَعْوَةٌ فِی الدُّنْیَا وَ لَا فِی الْاٰخِرَةِ وَ اَنَّ مَرَدَّنَاۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَ اَنَّ الْمُسْرِفِیْنَ هُمْ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ
ayahs.translation: There is no doubt that those whom you call me to have no claim to be called upon in this world and in the Hereafter. Certainly to Allah shall be our return, and those who exceed the limits are destined to the Fire.

ayahs.arabicText: فَسَتَذْكُرُوْنَ مَاۤ اَقُوْلُ لَكُمْ١ؕ وَ اُفَوِّضُ اَمْرِیْۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بَصِیْرٌۢ بِالْعِبَادِ
ayahs.translation: Soon you shall remember what I say to you. I entrust my affairs to Allah. Surely Allah is watchful over His servants.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَوَقٰىهُ اللّٰهُ سَیِّاٰتِ مَا مَكَرُوْا وَ حَاقَ بِاٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوْٓءُ الْعَذَابِۚ
ayahs.translation: Eventually Allah saved the person endowed with faith from all the evils of their guile, and a woeful chastisement encompassed the Pharaonites.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلنَّارُ یُعْرَضُوْنَ عَلَیْهَا غُدُوًّا وَّ عَشِیًّا١ۚ وَ یَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ١۫ اَدْخِلُوْۤا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ اَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ
ayahs.translation: They are exposed to the Fire every morning and evening; and when the Last Hour will come to pass, a command shall be given: “Admit the Pharaonites to an even more severe chastisement.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذْ یَتَحَآجُّوْنَ فِی النَّارِ فَیَقُوْلُ الضُّعَفٰٓؤُا لِلَّذِیْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْۤا اِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ اَنْتُمْ مُّغْنُوْنَ عَنَّا نَصِیْبًا مِّنَ النَّارِ
ayahs.translation: Just imagine when they will remonstrate with one another in Hell. The weak ones will say to those who waxed proud: “We were your followers. Will you, then, lighten for us a part of our suffering of the Fire?”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْۤا اِنَّا كُلٌّ فِیْهَاۤ١ۙ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَیْنَ الْعِبَادِ
ayahs.translation: Those who had waxed proud will reply: “All of us are in it. Allah has already passed His judgement among His servants.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ فِی النَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ادْعُوْا رَبَّكُمْ یُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا یَوْمًا مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ
ayahs.translation: Those suffering in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell: “Call upon your Lord to lighten the chastisement for us just for a day.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اَوَ لَمْ تَكُ تَاْتِیْكُمْ رُسُلُكُمْ بِالْبَیِّنٰتِ١ؕ قَالُوْا بَلٰى١ؕ قَالُوْا فَادْعُوْا١ۚ وَ مَا دُعٰٓؤُا الْكٰفِرِیْنَ اِلَّا فِیْ ضَلٰلٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: The keepers of Hell will ask: “Did your Messengers not come to you with Clear Signs?” They will say: “Yes (they did).” The keepers of Hell will say: “Then you yourselves should call (upon the Lord). And the call of the unbelievers will end in vain.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا لَنَنْصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا فِی الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا وَ یَوْمَ یَقُوْمُ الْاَشْهَادُۙ
ayahs.translation: Surely We shall help Our Messengers and the believers in the life of this world and on the Day when witnesses will rise to testify,

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ لَا یَنْفَعُ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَ لَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَ لَهُمْ سُوْٓءُ الدَّارِ
ayahs.translation: the Day when the excuses offered by the wrong-doers shall not avail them. They shall be victims of the curse and a woeful abode.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوْسَى الْهُدٰى وَ اَوْرَثْنَا بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَ الْكِتٰبَۙ
ayahs.translation: We surely guided Moses and made the Children of Israel the heirs of the Book

ayahs.arabicText: هُدًى وَّ ذِكْرٰى لِاُولِی الْاَلْبَابِ
ayahs.translation: which was a guidance and good counsel to people endowed with understanding and wisdom.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاصْبِرْ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّ اسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْۢبِكَ وَ سَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِالْعَشِیِّ وَ الْاِبْكَارِ
ayahs.translation: Be steadfast, then, (O Prophet), Allah's promise is true. Seek forgiveness for your shortcomings, and celebrate the praise of your Lord, evening and morning.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ یُجَادِلُوْنَ فِیْۤ اٰیٰتِ اللّٰهِ بِغَیْرِ سُلْطٰنٍ اَتٰىهُمْ١ۙ اِنْ فِیْ صُدُوْرِهِمْ اِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَّا هُمْ بِبَالِغِیْهِ١ۚ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللّٰهِ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِیْعُ الْبَصِیْرُ
ayahs.translation: Verily those who dispute regarding the Signs of Allah without any evidence that might have come to them, nothing but vain pride fills their hearts. Yet they shall never be able to satisfy the pride with which they are puffed up. So seek refuge with Allah. Verily He is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

ayahs.arabicText: لَخَلْقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ اَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely the creation of the heavens and the earth is a greater act than the creation of human beings. But most people do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا یَسْتَوِی الْاَعْمٰى وَ الْبَصِیْرُ١ۙ۬ وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ لَا الْمُسِیْٓءُ١ؕ قَلِیْلًا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Never can the blind and the seeing be equal; nor those that believe and act righteously and those that do evil. Little do you understand.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَاٰتِیَةٌ لَّا رَیْبَ فِیْهَا وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Hour will indeed come; there is no doubt about that. Yet most people do not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُوْنِیْۤ اَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ١ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ یَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِیْ سَیَدْخُلُوْنَ جَهَنَّمَ دٰخِرِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Your Lord said: “Pray to Me, and I will accept your prayers. Surely those who wax too proud to worship Me shall enter Hell, utterly abased.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّیْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوْا فِیْهِ وَ النَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَذُوْ فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا یَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allah it is Who made the night so that you may seek repose in it, and made the day radiant. Surely Allah is Most Bounteous to people; but most people do not give thanks.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ١ۘ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١ۚ٘ فَاَنّٰى تُؤْفَكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allah (Who bestowed all these favours upon you) is your Lord, the Creator of everything. There is no god but He. Whence are you, then, being led astray?

ayahs.arabicText: كَذٰلِكَ یُؤْفَكُ الَّذِیْنَ كَانُوْا بِاٰیٰتِ اللّٰهِ یَجْحَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Thus it is only those who had denied Allah's Signs that were led astray.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَّ السَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَّ صَوَّرَكُمْ فَاَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَ رَزَقَكُمْ مِّنَ الطَّیِّبٰتِ١ؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمْ١ۖۚ فَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allah it is Who made the earth a dwelling place for you and made the sky a canopy, Who shaped you -- and shaped you exceedingly well -- and gave you good things as sustenance. That is Allah, your Lord; blessed be Allah, the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: هُوَ الْحَیُّ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ فَادْعُوْهُ مُخْلِصِیْنَ لَهُ الدِّیْنَ١ؕ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: He is the Ever-Living: there is no god but He. So call upon Him, consecrating to Him all your devotion. All praise and thanks be to Allah, the Lord of the whole Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنِّیْ نُهِیْتُ اَنْ اَعْبُدَ الَّذِیْنَ تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِیَ الْبَیِّنٰتُ مِنْ رَّبِّیْ١٘ وَ اُمِرْتُ اَنْ اُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, (O Prophet): “I have been forbidden to worship those beside Allah whom you call upon. (How can I worship any beside Allah) when clear Signs have come to me from my Lord and I have been commanded to surrender to Allah, the Lord of the Universe?”

ayahs.arabicText: هُوَ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِّنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ یُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوْۤا اَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُوْنُوْا شُیُوْخًا١ۚ وَ مِنْكُمْ مَّنْ یُّتَوَفّٰى مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ لِتَبْلُغُوْۤا اَجَلًا مُّسَمًّى وَّ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He it is Who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clot; then He brings you out as an infant, then causes you to grow into full maturity, and then causes you to grow further so that you may reach old age, while some of you He recalls earlier. All this is in order that you may reach an appointed term and that you may understand (the Truth).

ayahs.arabicText: هُوَ الَّذِیْ یُحْیٖ وَ یُمِیْتُ١ۚ فَاِذَا قَضٰۤى اَمْرًا فَاِنَّمَا یَقُوْلُ لَهٗ كُنْ فَیَكُوْنُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: He it is Who gives life and causes death. Whenever He decrees a thing, He only commands to it “Be”, and it is.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِیْنَ یُجَادِلُوْنَ فِیْۤ اٰیٰتِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ اَنّٰى یُصْرَفُوْنَ٤ۖۛۚ
ayahs.translation: Did you not see those who dispute concerning Allah's Signs? Whence are they, then, being turned astray?

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِالْكِتٰبِ وَ بِمَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا بِهٖ رُسُلَنَا١ۛ۫ فَسَوْفَ یَعْلَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Those who gave the lie to this Book and all the Books which We had sent with Our Messengers shall soon come to know the Truth

ayahs.arabicText: اِذِ الْاَغْلٰلُ فِیْۤ اَعْنَاقِهِمْ وَ السَّلٰسِلُ١ؕ یُسْحَبُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: when fetters and chains shall be on their necks, and they shall be dragged into

ayahs.arabicText: فِی الْحَمِیْمِ١ۙ۬ ثُمَّ فِی النَّارِ یُسْجَرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: boiling water, and cast into the Fire.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ قِیْلَ لَهُمْ اَیْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تُشْرِكُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: It will then be said to them: “Where are those whom you

ayahs.arabicText: مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ قَالُوْا ضَلُّوْا عَنَّا بَلْ لَّمْ نَكُنْ نَّدْعُوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ شَیْئًا١ؕ كَذٰلِكَ یُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: associated with Allah in His Divinity?” They will say: “We have lost them; rather, we never used to call upon anyone before.” Thus will Allah cause them to stumble in error.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَفْرَحُوْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ بِغَیْرِ الْحَقِّ وَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَمْرَحُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: (They will be told): “This is because while you were on earth you took delight in untruth and exulted in it.

ayahs.arabicText: اُدْخُلُوْۤا اَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهَا١ۚ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Enter Hell now to abide in it. How woeful is the abode of those who wax proud!

ayahs.arabicText: فَاصْبِرْ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ١ۚ فَاِمَّا نُرِیَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِیْ نَعِدُهُمْ اَوْ نَتَوَفَّیَنَّكَ فَاِلَیْنَا یُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So be patient, (O Prophet). Surely Allah's promise is true. Whether We show them a part of the woeful consequences against which We warn them (while you are still in their midst) or We recall you (from this world) before that, eventually it is to Us that they shall be brought back.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ قَصَصْنَا عَلَیْكَ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَیْكَ١ؕ وَ مَا كَانَ لِرَسُوْلٍ اَنْ یَّاْتِیَ بِاٰیَةٍ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ١ۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمْرُ اللّٰهِ قُضِیَ بِالْحَقِّ وَ خَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْمُبْطِلُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Indeed We sent many Messengers before you: of them there are some whose account We have narrated to you and there are others whose account We have not narrated to you. It did not lie in any Messenger's power to bring any Sign except with Allah's leave. So when Allah's decree came, the matter was decided with justice, and those steeped in error courted utter loss, then and there.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَنْعَامَ لِتَرْكَبُوْا مِنْهَا وَ مِنْهَا تَاْكُلُوْنَ٘
ayahs.translation: Allah it is Who has made cattle for you so that you ride some of them and from some of them you derive food.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَكُمْ فِیْهَا مَنَافِعُ وَ لِتَبْلُغُوْا عَلَیْهَا حَاجَةً فِیْ صُدُوْرِكُمْ وَ عَلَیْهَا وَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: In them there are also other benefits for you, and through them you fulfil your heartfelt need (to reach places), and you are borne along upon them as upon the ships.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یُرِیْكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ١ۖۗ فَاَیَّ اٰیٰتِ اللّٰهِ تُنْكِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allah shows His Signs to you; then which of Allah's Signs will you deny?

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَمْ یَسِیْرُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ فَیَنْظُرُوْا كَیْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ١ؕ كَانُوْۤا اَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَ اَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَّ اٰثَارًا فِی الْاَرْضِ فَمَاۤ اَغْنٰى عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا یَكْسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Did they not journey in the land that they may behold the end of those who had gone before them? They were more numerous and greater in strength and left behind more splendid traces in the land. Yet their attainments did not avail them.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَیِّنٰتِ فَرِحُوْا بِمَا عِنْدَهُمْ مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ وَ حَاقَ بِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ یَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: When their Messengers came to them with Clear Signs, they arrogantly exulted in whatever knowledge they had. They were then encompassed by what they had mocked.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا رَاَوْا بَاْسَنَا قَالُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَحْدَهٗ وَ كَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهٖ مُشْرِكِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: When they saw Our chastisement, they said: “We have come to believe in Allah, the Only One, and we reject all what we had associated (with Allah in His Divinity).”

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمْ یَكُ یَنْفَعُهُمْ اِیْمَانُهُمْ لَمَّا رَاَوْا بَاْسَنَا١ؕ سُنَّتَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِیْ قَدْ خَلَتْ فِیْ عِبَادِهٖ١ۚ وَ خَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: But their believing after they had seen Our chastisement did not avail them. That has been Allah's Way concerning His servants. And the unbelievers courted utter loss, then and there.
